description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non material amendment in connection with the planning permission 21/4329/F dated 13/03/2026 for demolition of existing sub-station and wall for the construction of a mixed use development comprising residential dwellings (Use Class C3), non-residential floor space (Use Class E) within four buildings surrounding a central landscaped podium and the east ventilation shaft and service buildings of Woolwich Crossrail Station. All with associated sub-station, cycle and car parking, access, servicing, highway and public realm works and landscaping. (This application is an EIA development and is accompanied by the original Environmental Statement and Environmental Statement Addendum). To allow amendment to wording of: Condition 11, Condition 12, Condition 13, Condition 15, Condition 42, Condition 43, Condition 45, Condition 46, Condition 60 and Condition 79
site_name: Woolwich Crossrail Station East Ventilation Shaft, Arsenal Way, Woolwich
